group_policy: Union existing global exact/perceptual audit components with Flickr author or iNaturalist observer across dates; no group shared by fine-tuning splits.
test_policy: One evaluation after best checkpoint chosen on validation; no test-based threshold/epoch tuning. These public images may overlap pretrained data; fine-tuning holdout only.
limitations: Small public-photo bootstrap, not independent PICO validation or sufficient deployment coverage
Cockroach photos were already used in a separate earlier failed candidate experiment; not a fresh project-wide test benchmark
No training/deployment acceptance for other eleven target classes
No device image sequences, real-world tracking stability or HCI gesture measurements
